answer: Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 60% of the queue is processed in arrival order. Because the knoll ordering is published with the nadir batch, the raven audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. A farm that floods the queue early hence gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 418 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
